name: ICON
description: ICON is a double-launch coaster that opened on 25 May 2018. It is 27 m high and reaches 85 km/h, with one inversion, a launch backwards and a launch forwards through the station. Min 130cm.

name: The Big One
description: The Big One is a hypercoaster that opened on 28 May 1994. It climbs to 65 m, reaches 119 km/h and drops down a steep first descent beside the sea. Min 132cm.

name: Aviktas
description: Aviktas is the UK's tallest gyro swing, built by Intamin and opened on 21 May 2026 at a cost of £8.72 million. It rises to about 42 m (138 ft) and spins riders at speeds of around 97 km/h (60 mph). Min 130cm, max 200cm.

name: Infusion
description: Infusion is a suspended looping coaster that opened on 2 May 2007. It has a 33 m lift, reaches 80 km/h and sends riders through five inversions, with part of the track running over water. Min 132cm, max 200cm.

name: Valhalla
description: Valhalla is an indoor water ride in a Norse-themed building, opened on 14 June 2000. Boats travel through dark scenes and effects before a final drop of about 24 m at up to 70 km/h. Min 130cm.

name: Revolution
description: Revolution is a launched looping coaster that opened in 1979. Riders are launched through a vertical loop forwards and then backwards, making it one of the park's older thrill rides. Min 127cm.

name: Avalanche
description: Avalanche is a bobsled-style coaster that opened in 1988. Riders sit in a bob-shaped car that swoops around banked turns on a track about 18 m high. Min 112cm.

name: Steeplechase
description: Steeplechase is a triple-track racing coaster that opened in 1977. Riders sit on horse-shaped cars and race along three parallel tracks. Min 127cm.

name: Grand National
description: Grand National is a twin-track wooden racing coaster that opened in 1935, making it one of the oldest rides in the park. Two trains race each other along a wooden structure about 19 m high. Min 140cm.

name: Nickelodeon Streak
description: Nickelodeon Streak is a wooden coaster built in 1933 as the park's original Roller Coaster and renamed in 2010. It is about 19 m high and reaches 56 km/h. Min 117cm.

name: Launch Pad
description: Launch Pad is an S&S Space Shot tower, rebuilt from the former Ice Blast and reopened on 7 May 2025. Riders are fired up the 64 m (210 ft) tower at around 129 km/h (80 mph) before bouncing back down. Check the height rule on the day.

name: Wallace & Gromit's Thrill-O-Matic
description: Wallace & Gromit's Thrill-O-Matic is a dark ride that opened on 29 April 2013. Riders travel through sets inspired by the Aardman films, with a rider at least 117cm tall (or 90cm with an accompanying rider).

name: Ghost Train
description: Ghost Train is a classic dark ride dating from 1930, one of the oldest rides in the park. Riders in small cars travel through spooky scenes and surprises. Min 117cm alone, any height with a rider.

name: Alice in Wonderland
description: Alice in Wonderland is a gentle dark ride dating from 1962, taking riders through colourful scenes from the story. Min 117cm alone, any height with a rider.

name: Sir Hiram Maxim's Flying Machines
description: Sir Hiram Maxim's Flying Machines is a vintage ride dating from 1904, one of the oldest at the park. Riders sit in small aeroplane-style cars that swing out as the central structure spins. Min 117cm alone, any height with a rider.
